INSERT INTO experiment_assignments
  (experiment_id, customer_id, variant, eligibility_snapshot, assignment_key)
SELECT
  'EXP-001',
  r.customer_id,
  CASE WHEN get_byte(decode(md5('EXP-001:' || r.customer_id), 'hex'), 0) % 2 = 0
       THEN 'treatment' ELSE 'control' END,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'next_action', r.next_action,
    'segment', r.segment,
    'policy_version', r.policy_version,
    'consent_status', c.consent_status),
  md5('EXP-001:' || r.customer_id)
FROM action_recommendations r
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.approval_status = 'approved'
  AND r.next_action = 'personalized_reminder'
  AND c.consent_status = 'opted_in'
ON CONFLICT (experiment_id, customer_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING customer_id, variant, assignment_key;

WITH t AS (
  SELECT customer_id FROM experiment_assignments
  WHERE experiment_id = 'EXP-001' AND variant = 'treatment'
),
s AS (
  INSERT INTO campaign_events (campaign_id, experiment_id, customer_id, event_type, message_variant)
  SELECT 'CMP-001', 'EXP-001', customer_id, 'sent', 'reminder_v1' FROM t
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING customer_id
),
d AS (
  INSERT INTO campaign_events (campaign_id, experiment_id, customer_id, event_type, message_variant)
  SELECT 'CMP-001', 'EXP-001', customer_id, 'delivered', 'reminder_v1' FROM s WHERE random() < 0.97
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING customer_id
),
o AS (
  INSERT INTO campaign_events (campaign_id, experiment_id, customer_id, event_type, message_variant)
  SELECT 'CMP-001', 'EXP-001', customer_id, 'opened', 'reminder_v1' FROM d WHERE random() < 0.40
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING customer_id
),
c AS (
  INSERT INTO campaign_events (campaign_id, experiment_id, customer_id, event_type, message_variant)
  SELECT 'CMP-001', 'EXP-001', customer_id, 'clicked', 'reminder_v1' FROM o WHERE random() < 0.25
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING customer_id
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s) AS sent,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM d) AS delivered,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o) AS opened,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM c) AS clicked;
